scope_note: Independent visual review of receipts only. No integration, manifest, research or power changes. For each of the 3 requested slugs I viewed the native 1254px PNG, a 200px thumbnail, and targeted native crops (kunekune: head/torso, both arms, feet, background haze, plus a 420px downscale; matuku-tangotango: face, both hands, weapon blade, cloak, brightened shaft; mulher-marinha: face, both hands, torso, legs/fins, hooves). I compared them against the receipt visual_requirements and the research claims (statements and source quotes) embedded in the ledger, and against the earlier Claude correction notes (2118-r01/r03). Before writing, each PNG SHA-256 was recomputed and matched against the receipt native_sha256, the Codex visual_review hash, the ledger item hash and the Codex root native-review hash in drafts/root/codex-native-reviews.json. Claude wrote only root_visual_review (plus correction_notes on the reject) and the receipt status, and synced only the ledger item status; each receipt and the ledger were re-read immediately before writing. No PNG, Codex visual_review, Codex native review or other receipt was modified. Reject: kunekune-urban-legend (limbs, head and cloth hang limp under gravity, so the documented gust-like wriggle is lost; the photographic, puffy papier-mache effigy reads as a scarecrow or paper-art installation in a pleasant paddy, not a dangerous living being).

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px and 420px downscales, and head/torso, both-arm, feet and background crops. What works and answers r03: one white crumpled fine-fabric/paper humanoid (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c04) with one blank head and no face, two arms ending in crumpled tips with no fingers, and two legs. Both feet are planted in the paddy mud with no contrapposto, and there is no bust or hourglass waist. The head hangs at a broken sideways angle, and the low, off-centre camera has the figure leaning over the viewer. The rice and the paddy water are still, the sky is bleached white and the foot shadow is hard (c01/c11/c12). No text, aura, curse effect or borrowed design. It still fails the sangar test, because the being reads as an inanimate object, not as something alive wriggling wrongly. (1) Nothing moves. Both arms, the head and the body cloth hang straight down under gravity like wet crepe-paper streamers, and the head sags like a sack. Nothing streams or flutters as in the documented 'straight gust of wind' (c12), so the defining wriggle that gives the being its name (c03/c13) is lost, and the requested convulsion reads as slumping. (2) The image is rendered as a photograph of a puffy, crumpled papier-mache effigy standing in a sunny, vivid green paddy. It has a large, lumpy paper-ball head and paper-boot feet. It reads as a scarecrow or an outdoor paper-art installation. That is both the mundane explanation in c10 and the 'sculpture, land art or model' that the receipt's own prompt excluded, and it is not the painterly house style the prompt asked for. The heat haze warping the far rows, asked for in r03 and in the prompt, is not visible; the far line is only pale haze. At 200px it is an odd, sad paper figure in a pleasant field, not something dangerous. It fails Uji Sangar #2, #3 and #7.
results.correction_notes: Keep: one slender white fine-fabric/paper humanoid with a blank, faceless head, two arms, two legs and no fingers (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c04). Keep both feet planted in or beside the paddy, the rice and the paddy water dead still, and humanlike height. Keep the bleached white noon sky with a hard, short shadow (c01/c11), and the low, close, off-centre camera with the figure leaning over the viewer. Fix: (a) Make the wriggle visible as motion against gravity, not sagging. Both arms and the loose edges of the torso stream and whip sideways in ONE direction, as if in a strong straight gust (c12). They are lifted horizontally and ripple in tight, uneven waves, with fluttering, snapping edges and slightly blurred tips. Meanwhile every rice blade and the glassy water show absolutely no wind. The contradiction between gale-blown cloth and a dead-still field is the wrongness (c03/c12/c13). Nothing hangs limp. (b) Make it a living presence, not an object. Give it a flat, thin, sheet-like body like a strip of fine cloth (c04), not puffy crumpled paper tubes. Make the head a narrow blank shape of the same cloth, not a large lumpy paper ball, and give it no boot-like feet. Paint it in the house painterly style with visible brushwork, not as a photograph of a papier-mache figure. It must never read as a scarecrow or an art installation (c10 gives scarecrows as the mundane explanation). (c) Show heat haze visibly warping the far paddy line and treeline. No face, eyes, mouth, aura, curse or madness effects (c08), and no text.

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, weapon-blade, cloak and brightened shaft crops. This redraw answers all four r03 points. (a) The weapon is one long, plain, dark hardwood staff with a broad, flat, leaf-shaped paddle-edged blade at its upper end: the two-handed wooden sword (matuku-tangotango-c07) in the Maori-form interpretation Claude asked for. It has no crossguard, pommel, metal or carving. (b) Both hands grip the same continuous shaft, one at chest height and one at the waist with a length of shaft between them. Each hand has normal fingers and no extra digits. (c) He heaves himself out of a deep earthen shaft whose root-laced walls drop into black. One knee is on the rim, the other leg descends into the dark, and soil and roots pour from his hair, cloak and weapon (he lives beneath the earth and rises from it, c02/c06/c07/c09). A thin crescent moon hangs low in the dusk sky (the new moon appears, c03/c06; the exact phase is editorial) above his washing pool (c03). (d) He is one humanlike ogre-chief (c09) with one head, two eyes and long dark hair tangled with roots (c04). His clay-caked, grey-bearded, weathered face roars straight at the viewer, with ordinary teeth and no invented horns, fangs or giant scale. The earth crust and the underground emergence make him a being risen from under the earth, not an ordinary present-day man in a ditch. The face is still finely realistic, but the clay crust and the painted sky, blade and soil keep it within the house style. The coarse cloak reads as plaited flax strips (editorial) and is fully opaque, over a dark opaque lower garment. No victim, gore, text or aura. At 200px the roaring, earth-crusted figure climbing out of the ground with a raised weapon is menacing. Limitation: the blade silhouette is close to a canoe paddle, which is an acceptable result of the requested paddle-edged form.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, torso, leg/fin and hoof crops. This redraw answers the r03 reject. One adult woman (mulher-marinha-c01) with one head and two eyes. Her face is grave and weathered, with a furrowed brow, a closed mouth and a steady, direct gaze, and heavy wet dark hair clings to her shoulders. No makeup, smile or parted-lip glamour. Her dark sea-green top is high-necked, long-sleeved and fully opaque. Two arms: the raised open palm greeting the viewer and the hand steadying her on the basalt each have a thumb plus four fingers. From the waist down she is covered in irregular, overlapping, wet silver-green scales that read as her own body, not as leggings (c02). Two separate legs each carry a large, ragged, translucent, ribbed fin along the outer side (fins along her legs, c02). They end in two large cloven goat hooves, each clearly split into two horn halves (goat's feet, c01/c02). No fish tail. A big breaking wave towers behind her, and seawater pours off her arms and legs as she steps out of the sea onto black rock at night (she leaves the water, c03). The sky is storm cloud with a moonlit break, with no sun disc or sunset. The low camera gives a towering heroic view. Only her face and hands show skin and nothing is revealing, so the framing does not read as sexualised. No aura, magic, kelp, text or borrowed design. She is benevolent and grave, as section 6.5 asks: at 200px the towering, finned, hoofed daughter of the sea before the storm wave inspires awe, and does not read as a costume pose on a beach.
